title: DiffSense Audit Report
description: Machine-readable output contract for diffsense audit/replay. schema_version MUST be validated first; unknown or older versions MUST NOT be parsed greedily. See docs/cli-contract.md for semantics.

schema_version.description: Version of this JSON contract. Consumers MUST abort on unsupported versions.

review_level.description: Composed risk level. 'critical' is the blocking threshold (see cli-contract.md).

impacts.description: Impact summary keyed by category or file.

details.description: Per-finding detail entries. Shape is intentionally open; key fields (rule id, severity, message) are documented in cli-contract.md.

confidence.description: Overall confidence of the composed decision.

suggested_action.description: Suggested next action; advisory only, never enforced by the tool.

error.description: Present only on tool-error reports (review_level='error'); human-readable failure detail.

description_note: additionalProperties is intentionally permissive: private/underscore fields (_metrics, _rule_quality, _quality_warnings, _performance) and future additive fields MUST NOT fail validation. Breaking removals require a schema_version bump per cli-contract.md.
